brief: Build the deterministic decision core and the only process that holds the wallet agent's key. Read spec 2.2, 2.5, 2.6, 5.1-5.2, 6 (all), 7 (all), 9.2 and 13.3 (policy.yaml). brief: Build the LLM-facing wallet agent (process P2, holds no private keys). Read spec 2.1-2.4, 5.2, 6.1-6.3, 6.5 (PAY_CAPPED execution), 8 (all), 9.2-9.3, 10.1 (LLM modes) and 13.3 (agent.yaml). The LLM picks exactly one tool per turn from the closed set of the turn type: owner turns (reply_to_owner, ask_clarification, draft_mandate, amend_mandate, request_quotes, explain, show_status, freeze_wallet) and invoice turns (decide_invoice, reply_to_owner). Counterparty messages never start a turn; reports are filed by code. Purchase runtime: for each request_quotes item create a single-use quoteRequestId bound to mandate, payee, sku and quantity (persist under data/<network>/agent/ atomically), call the provider, run validate_invoice before any LLM sees the invoice, compute the policy preview, re-quote by code when the preview is the non-executable PAY_CAPPED, give the LLM one invoice from one counterparty with memo and descriptions quarantined (random-boundary DATA blocks, masking per config), validate the tool call (amounts as strings converted with Decimal, sku enum built from the pinned catalogue), run decide (pass 1), send ExecuteRequest to the signer, then delivery: escrow -> wait for the provider's claim, run the deterministic payload check, ask RELEASE; direct pay -> poll until deadline + grace, judge ON_TIME/LATE by the chain-clock receipt time, ask RECORD_DELIVERY. After a REFUSE with an adverse invoice, file INJECTION_ATTEMPT via the signer; after FAILED, NON_DELIVERY; after >= 3 dropped signed unsolicited invoices from one issuer, SPAM. The directory is the pinned agents map of deployments/<network>.json (never the simulator or global ERC-8004 names); forced clarifications show agentId, grade, wallet, registration age and lookalike warnings. Redactor matches exact secret values (keccak compare), BIP-39 runs and key prefixes, never 32-byte hash shapes. MockLLM rules use policy_preview.tool_action; the naive persona is spec 8.7. OpenAICompatClient: temperature 0, LLM_EXTRA_BODY, retry with tool_choice='auto' on HTTP 400, then json mode; no reliance on seed. Dialogue evaluation per 8.9 with at least 30 intents (>= 3 in Chinese).
